product_from_film: End Close reconciles payment records and delegates exceptions to AI agents.

lessons.keep: Keep the visible exception and Delegate to agent action.
try: Trim ten seconds of the setup and show the same exception reach resolved status with its matched invoice.
Enlarge the agent checklist and keep the case identifier visible through every step, including the final notification.
lessons.avoid: Avoid cutting from an in-progress agent step to a completed-result claim.
lessons.open: Audio is unheard. Resolution accuracy, autonomy, speed and experience claims remain unverified.
